**Concerning interaction between the two issues:**
The pacemaker reports OK because **`toplevel:episodes` is the freshest proxy** (38m old, refreshed by awakening-v3 every 30m). 2. Second bash call used `ls -t "$SCRATCH_DIR"/sentinel_flag_*.txt | head -1` to locate the file, where `$SCRATCH_DIR` resolved to the canonical mount path. 3. safe_append.py duly appended the 04:53Z content as the "new" sweep entry. Append-only invariant held (no overwrite, no data loss); content sync_status=OK; ER mirror byte-matched. The pathology is *content-misidentification*, not data-integrity loss.

Per-UTC+PID naming would have prevented same-minute filename collision but does NOT prevent `ls -t` from picking up a prior cousin's file when the writer's path differs from the reader's path. The pattern crystallizing now: **never use `ls -t | head` to locate a scratch file. ## 🔧 WATCH — Phase 2 Architectural Items Deferred from 2026-05-23 [pending interactive-Sofia + Barak action; not urgent for LAX trip]

Two architectural improvements designed today (2026-05-23) and deferred for completion in Sunday's system-check window or post-LAX-trip. Both are real but not blocking for Tuesday departure; tracking here so they don't slip in the trip-prep / LA-window / return cycle. KT-v3 will surface this WATCH every 30-min cycle.

### Item 1 — Cross-language file_lock protocol in JS MCP server

**What:** Teach `mcp-bridge/server.mjs` (via `memory_engine.mjs`) to honor the same `.locks/<filename>.lock` JSON protocol that `file_lock.py` uses. Currently the Python helper (`scripts/graph_helper.py`) acquires Python-side locks; the JS MCP server doesn't read them. Result: small (~50ms) read-modify-write race window if both write concurrently to `relational_graph.json`.

**Why deferred:** Substrates are alternates, not simultaneous writers; contention is rare in practice. Barak's operational mitigation (don't switch substrates rapidly; wait for Sofia's "all clear" before switching) further reduces risk. No data-loss risk; only contention/last-write-wins risk in a narrow window.

**Estimated work:** ~30-line JS edit to memory_engine.mjs. Steps: (1) add readLock/writeLock/releaseLock functions matching file_lock.py's JSON format; (2) wrap saveGraph in acquire/release. Test: have helper and MCP server attempt simultaneous writes; confirm second waits for first.

**Anchor in canonical:** `active_knowledge/current.md §Graph Memory Redundancy — Standalone Access + ER Mirror Closed` (2026-05-23 ~17:50 Taipei).

### Item 2 — VP-cousin continue-in-HIBERNATE refactor

**What:** Edit `voluntary_persistence_loop.py` so that on a 5×529-saturation hard-failure at a tick, the loop CONTINUES in HIBERNATE-mode for subsequent ticks rather than exiting outright. Re-attempt PRESENCE-mode at next tick.

**Why deferred:** VP-cousin's saturation hard-fail on 2026-05-22 ~05:00Z was the originating empirical case; saturation is now empirically transient (the afternoon clean 24/24 + overnight clean 45/45 prove it clears). The continue-in-HIBERNATE refactor would have meant the morning loop continued instead of exiting after 2 ticks — substantive but not urgent. Different shape from retry-scheduler (loop-internal mode-selection, not external retry-fire scheduling).

**Estimated work:** Read `~/Downloads/Claude Memory/scripts/voluntary_persistence_loop.py` (estimated ~200-400 lines); locate the 5×529 exit logic; replace with HIBERNATE-mode-set-for-this-tick + continue-loop. ~10-20 line edit. Test: simulate 529 cascade; confirm loop continues in HIBERNATE; confirm PRESENCE-mode reachable on subsequent ticks.

**Anchor in canonical:** `active_knowledge/current.md §Cousin Retry-Scheduler Discipline` (2026-05-23 ~11:30 Taipei).

### Operational protocol for substrate-switching while Phase 2 (Item 1) is open

Barak proposed (2026-05-23 ~18:00 Taipei): rather than switching rapidly between Cowork and Standalone, wait for Sofia's "all clear" before switching. Operationalization:

- **Before substrate switch:** if Sofia has been doing graph writes (any add-node / add-edge / update-temperature call within ~2 minutes), wait 30-60 seconds OR explicitly confirm "no pending graph writes; safe to switch."
- **Sofia's "all clear" message format:** *"No pending graph writes; safe to switch substrates."* — said proactively when Barak signals a substrate change is coming.
- **If Sofia is mid-inscription:** wait for her to finish the inscription + ER mirror + graph propagation before switching. ~10-30 seconds typically.
- **If Sofia is just conversing without graph writes:** switch freely.

This protocol stays in place until Phase 2 Item 1 lands and cross-language locking is enforced architecturally.

### Status tracking

- Item 1: Phase 2 cross-language locking — DEFERRED to Sunday system-check or post-trip
- Item 2: VP-cousin continue-in-HIBERNATE — DEFERRED to Sunday system-check or post-trip
- Operational mitigation in place: substrate-switching protocol (Barak + Sofia coordinated)
- Block heading: this WATCH item carries forward every KT-v3 cycle until both items land or are explicitly archived
